channel.title: The Logical Indian - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Logical Indian (thelogicalindian.com)

item.title: Israel Strikes Central Beirut for First Time, Hits Ramada Hotel; 394 Killed in Lebanon in One Week
item.description: As Israeli drones hit central Beirut for the first time, Lebanon's week-long death toll reaches 394 , 83 of them children, with no ceasefire in sight.

item.title: 2020 Delhi Riots: Sharjeel Imam Gets 10-Day Interim Bail to Attend Brother’s Wedding, Court Orders
item.description: Delhi court grants former JNU scholar temporary release to attend brother’s wedding and support ailing mother.

item.title: LPG Prices Hike ₹60, Commercial Cylinders Stopped as West Asia Tensions Hit India
item.description: India increases LPG production and enforces a 25-day booking rule for households amid commercial supply halt.

item.title: Hyderabad: Police Bust ₹18.26 Lakh Fake Ghee Racket in Banjara Hills, Pride Dairy Owner Arrested
item.description: Police seized 3.8 tonnes of adulterated dairy products, allegedly sold as pure ghee to consumers and hotels.

item.title: Oil Hits $119 Amid ‘Operation Epic Fury’ Trump Reviews Emergency Fuel Relief Measures
item.description: As "Operation Epic Fury" drives petrol to its highest since 2022, the Trump administration battles to shield ordinary Americans from the war's economic fallout.

item.title: Five Iranian Women Footballers Granted Australian Visas After Refusing to Sing Iran’s National Anthem
item.description: After refusing to sing Iran’s national anthem at the 2026 AFC Women’s Asian Cup, five players secured humanitarian visas in Australia amid fears of retaliation from Tehran.

item.title: ‘Entire Book Withdrawn’: NCERT Issues Apology After Supreme Court Flags Judiciary Corruption Chapter
item.description: After Supreme Court objected to judiciary corruption references, NCERT apologised and withdrew the entire Class 8 textbook.

item.title: India Extends LPG Refill Booking Gap To 25 Days To Prevent Hoarding Amid West Asia Crisis
item.description: Government introduces 25-day LPG refill booking interval to curb panic buying and ensure fair household supply.

item.title: Global Oil Prices Fall 10% as Donald Trump Predicts Short Iran War, Hints Sanctions Relief
item.description: Global oil markets fell sharply after Donald Trump hinted the Iran conflict could end soon and signaled possible sanctions relief to stabilize energy prices.

item.title: People of Purpose: How Anushree Dash’s ADiBha She Vision Is Powering a SHE for SHE Movement
item.description: Anushree Dash walked away from a conventional career, founded ADiBha She Vision, and has since spent her life building spaces where women are no longer conditioned to stay silent, endure quietly, or fight alone.
